description.short: Your pipeline, accounts, renewals, invoices, cases and new leads in Copilot.
description.full: Brillienta CRM brings your CRM into Microsoft 365 Copilot. Ask for your pipeline with AI deal health, a 360 summary of any account, subscriptions renewing soon, overdue invoices or support cases at risk of breaching their SLA, and add new leads from a conversation. Data stays in your own SharePoint site and every answer uses your own CRM permissions.
